Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.af: Aanbeveel: stel 'n pasgemaakte CPC-begroting as jy handmatige beheer oor besteding en bod wil hê.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.zu: Kunconyiwe: setha ibhajethi ye-CPC yangokwezifiso uma ufuna ukulawula okwenziwa ngesandla phezu kwezindleko namabhidi.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.xh: Kuyacetyiswa: seta uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwe-CPC ukuba ufuna ulawulo lwezandla kwinkcitho kunye neebhidi.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.st: E khothalelitsoe: beha tekanyetso ea CPC e tloaelehileng haeba u batla ho laola tšebeliso ea chelete le litefiso.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.nso: E kgothaletšwa: beakanya tekanyetšo ya CPC ya tlwaelo ge o nyaka taolo ya seatla godimo ga tšhomišo ya tšhelete le dipeeletšo.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.tn: E kgothaletswa: seta tekanyetsokabo ya CPC e e tlwaelegileng fa e le gore o batla taolo ya diatla ya tiriso ya madi le dikopo.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.ts: Swi ringanyetiwa: veka mpimanyeto wa CPC wa ntolovelo loko u lava vulawuri bya mavoko eka matirhiselo ya mali na tibidhi.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.ve: Zwo themendelwa: vheani mugaganyagwama wa CPC wo khetheaho arali ni tshi ṱoḓa ndaulo ya zwanḓa kha u shumisa masheleni na u ṋetshedza.
Recommended: set a custom CPC budget if.ss: Kunconyiwe: setha isabelomali se-CPC ngekwemkhuba uma ufuna kulawula ngesandla ngetulu kwekucitsa imali kanye nemabhidi.

Adds wallet store credit to the particip.af: Voeg beursiewinkelkrediet by die deelnemer se rekening (vereis 'n kliëntrekening).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.zu: Ingeza ikhredithi yesitolo sesikhwama semali ku-akhawunti yombambi qhaza (idinga i-akhawunti yekhasimende).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.xh: Yongeza i-wallet store credit kwi-akhawunti yomthathi-nxaxheba (ifuna i-akhawunti yomthengi).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.st: E eketsa mokitlane oa lebenkele la lichelete ho akhaonto ea motho ea nkang karolo (e hloka akhaonto ea bareki).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.nso: E tlaleletša mokitlana wa lebenkele la sepache go akhaonto ya motšwasehlabelo (e nyaka akhaonto ya moreki).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.tn: E tsenya sekoloto sa lebenkele la sepatšhe mo akhaontong ya motsayakarolo (e tlhoka akhaonto ya moreki).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.ts: Ku engetela xikweleti xa xitolo xa xipachi eka akhawunti ya mutekaxiave (swi lava akhawunti ya muxavi).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.ve: I engedza tshikolodo tsha vhengele ḽa tshipatshi kha akhaunthu ya muṱanganedzi (i ṱoḓa akhaunthu ya khasiṱama).
Adds wallet store credit to the particip.ss: Kwengeta sikweleti sesitolo sesikhwama semali ku-akhawunti yemhlanganyeli (kudzinga i-akhawunti yekhasimende).

Enter the serial from your device label.af: Voer die reeks vanaf jou toesteletiket in wanneer jy die masjien byvoeg, of kontak ondersteuning.
Enter the serial from your device label.zu: Faka uchungechunge olusuka kulebula yedivayisi yakho lapho ungeza umshini, noma xhumana nabosekelo.
Enter the serial from your device label.xh: Faka uthotho olusuka kwileyibhile yesixhobo sakho xa usongeza umatshini, okanye qhagamshelana nenkxaso.
Enter the serial from your device label.st: Kenya serial ho tsoa ho leibole ea sesebelisoa sa hau ha u eketsa mochini, kapa ikopanye le tšehetso.
Enter the serial from your device label.nso: Tsenya seriale go tšwa go leina la gago la sedirišwa ge o oketša motšhene, goba ikgokaganye le thekgo.
Enter the serial from your device label.tn: Tsenya serial go tswa mo leiboleng ya sediriswa sa gago fa o tsenya motšhini, kgotsa ikgolaganye le tshegetso.
Enter the serial from your device label.ts: Nghenisa serial ku suka eka lebula ya xitirhisiwa xa wena loko u engetela muchini, kumbe u tihlanganisa na nseketelo.
Enter the serial from your device label.ve: Ṅwalani serial u bva kha ḽebuḽu ya tshishumiswa tshaṋu musi ni tshi engedza mutshini, kana ni kwame thikhedzo.
Enter the serial from your device label.ss: Faka i-serial kusuka kulebuli yedivayisi yakho uma wengeta umshini, noma utsintse ukwesekwa.

Yoco card terminals and hosted checkout.af: Yoco kaartterminale en gehuisvesde betaalpunt is nie tans vir hierdie mark beskikbaar nie.
Yoco card terminals and hosted checkout.zu: Yoco amatheminali amakhadi kanye nokuphuma okusingathiwe akutholakali kule makethe njengamanje.

Yoco card terminals and hosted checkout.nso: Yoco ditheminali tša dikarata le go tšhela ka mo go amogetšwego ga di hwetšagale bakeng sa mmaraka wo gona bjale.
Yoco card terminals and hosted checkout.tn: Yoco ditheminale tsa dikarata le go reka go go amogetsweng ga go yo mo mmarakeng ono gone jaanong.
Yoco card terminals and hosted checkout.ts: Yoco titheminali ta makhadi na hosted checkout a swi kumeki eka makete lowu sweswi.
Yoco card terminals and hosted checkout.ve: Yoco zwiṱitshi zwa khadi na u bvisa tshelede zwo ṱanganedzwaho a zwi wanali kha makete uyu zwa zwino.
Yoco card terminals and hosted checkout.ss: Yoco ematheminali emakhadi kanye nekukhipha lokusingatsiwe akutfolakali kulemakethe nyalo.

Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.af: Skep 'n betaallopie vir 'n weeklikse of maandelikse tydperk. Keur dit dan goed en merk dit hier betaal.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.zu: Dala inkokhelo yesikhathi samasonto onke noma sanyanga zonke. Bese ugunyaza futhi umake ukuthi ikhokhelwe lapha.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.xh: Yenza umvuzo weveki okanye ngenyanga. Emva koko uvume kwaye uphawule ukuba ihlawulwe apha.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.st: Theha mokhoa oa ho lefa bakeng sa nako ea beke kapa khoeli le khoeli. Ebe u amohela 'me u tšoaee hore e lefiloe mona.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.nso: Hlama go kitima ga mogolo bakeng sa nako ya beke le beke goba ya kgwedi le kgwedi. Ke moka o dumele le go e swaya e lefilwe mo.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.tn: Tlhama tatelano ya tuelo ya paka ya beke le beke kgotsa ya kgwedi le kgwedi. Go tswa foo o e amogele le go e tshwaya e duetswe fano.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.ts: Endla ku tsutsuma ka muholo ka nkarhi wa vhiki na vhiki kumbe n’hweti na n’hweti. Kutani pfumelela u tlhela u fungha yi hakeriwile laha.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.ve: U sika pay run ya tshifhinga tsha vhege kana nwedzi. Nga murahu ni tende na u swaya uri yo badelwa hafha.
Create a pay run for a weekly or monthly.ss: Dala umgijimi wekukhokha sikhatsi seliviki noma senyanga. Ngemuva kwaloko uvume bese umaka kutsi ukhokhelwe lapha.

Recurring bookings need a saved client p.tn: Dipeeletso tse di ipoeletsang di tlhoka porofaele ya tlelaente e e bolokilweng gore maeto a mo isagweng a kgone go laolwa ka pabalesego.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.ts: Ku bukuta loku vuyeleriwaka ku lava phurofayili ya tiklayenti leyi hlayisiweke leswaku maendzo ya nkarhi lowu taka ya ta lawuriwa hi ku hlayiseka.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.ve: U buka zwine zwa dzulela u itea zwi ṱoḓa phrofaili ya khasiṱama yo vhulungwaho u itela uri madalo a tshifhinga tshi ḓaho a kone u langiwa nga nḓila yo tsireledzeaho.
Recurring bookings need a saved client p.ss: Kubhukha lokuphindzaphindvwako kudzinga iphrofayli yeklayenti legciniwe kute kuvakashela esikhatsini lesitako kulawulwe ngendlela lephephile.

Using platform defaults for upselling. S.af: Gebruik platformstandaarde vir meerverkope. Stoor om jou eie voorkeur op hierdie toestel te stel.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.zu: Ukusebenzisa okuzenzakalelayo kweplathifomu ukuze uthengise. Londoloza ukuze usethe izintandokazi zakho kule divayisi.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.xh: Ukusebenzisa iqonga elimiselweyo ukuthengisa. Gcina ukuseta ukhetho lwakho kwesi sixhobo.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.st: Ho sebelisa li-platform tsa kamehla bakeng sa ho rekisa. Boloka ho ipehela khetho ea hau sesebelisoa sena.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.nso: Go šomiša di-default tša sefala bakeng sa upselling. Boloka go beakanya kgetho ya gago go sedirišwa se.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.tn: Go dirisa ditlhomamiso tsa polatefomo go rekisa. Boloka go seta kgetho ya gago mo sedirisweng seno.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.ts: Ku tirhisa ti platform defaults eka upselling. Hlayisa ku veka ku tsakela ka wena eka xitirhisiwa lexi.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.ve: U shumisa zwithu zwa pulatifomo zwa u rengisa. Vhulungani u itela u setha zwine na zwi takalela kha tshishumiswa itshi.
Using platform defaults for upselling. S.ss: Kusebentisa ipulatifomu lejwayelekile yekutsengisa. Gcina kute usethe lokutsandzako kuledivayisi.

Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.af: Virtuele betaalpunt skep betaalskakels en QR-kodes sonder 'n fisiese terminaal.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.zu: Ukukhokha okubonakalayo kudala izixhumanisi zokukhokha ezisingathiwe namakhodi e-QR ngaphandle kwetheminali ebonakalayo.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.xh: Ukuphuma okubonakalayo kwenza amakhonkco entlawulo ebanjwe kunye neekhowudi ze-QR ngaphandle kwe-terminal ebonakalayo.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.st: Virtual Checkout e theha lihokelo tsa ho lefa tse tsamaisoang le likhoutu tsa QR ntle le terminal ea 'mele.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.nso: Virtual checkout bopa hosted tefo dikgokelo le QR dikhoutu ntle le terminal 'mele.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.tn: Go reka ka khomphiutha go dira dikgokagano tsa tuelo tse di amogetsweng le dikhoutu tsa QR kwantle ga theminale ya mmatota.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.ts: Virtual checkout yi tumbuluxa swihlanganisi swa hakelo leswi khomiweke na tikhodi ta QR handle ka theminali ya xiviri.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.ve: U bvisa ha vhukuma zwi sika vhuṱumani ha mbadelo ho ṱanganedzwaho na khoudu dza QR hu si na theminala ya vhukuma.
Virtual checkout creates hosted payment.ss: Kukhipha imali nge-inthanethi kwenta tikhonjiso tekukhokha letisingatsiwe kanye nemakhodi e-QR ngaphandle kwetheminali lebonakalako.

Photo library access is needed to choose.ts: Ku nghena eka layiburari ya swifaniso swa laveka ku hlawula xifaniso. U nga yi pfumelela eka swiyimiso swa sisiteme.

A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.ve: Bili ya utility, tshitatamennde tsha bannga, kana lease ine ya vha na dzina lavho khayo, i si ya kale u fhira minwedzi ya 3.
A utility bill, bank statement, or lease.ss: Ibhili yetinsita, sitatimende sasebhange, noma i-lease leneligama lakho, lengakapheli tinyanga letingu-3.

Online booking for this provider require.tn: Go buka ka inthanete ga moabi yono go tlhoka gore badiri ba tlhophiwe. Buka ka webosaete boemong jwa seo.

Check your current and new email for lin.ss: Hlola i-imeyili yakho yamanje nalensha kute utfole tikhonjiso tekucinisekisa lushintjo (kokubili kungadzingeka).

Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.af: Beautonomi kan nie stootwaarskuwings stuur totdat jy kennisgewings in jou foon se instellings toelaat nie.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.zu: Beautonomi ayikwazi ukuthumela izexwayiso kuze kube yilapho uvumela izaziso kuzilungiselelo zefoni yakho.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.xh: Beautonomi ayikwazi ukuthumela izilumkiso zokutyhala de uvumele izaziso kuseto lwefowuni yakho.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.st: Beautonomi ha e khone ho romela litlhokomeliso ho fihlela u lumella litemoso ho litlhophiso tsa fono ea hau.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.nso: Beautonomi ga e kgone go romela ditemošo tša go kgorometša go fihlela o dumelela ditsebišo ka gare ga dipeakanyo tša mogala wa gago.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.tn: Beautonomi ga e kgone go romela ditsiboso tsa push go fitlha o letla dikitsiso mo diseting tsa founo ya gago.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.ts: Beautonomi a wu nge swi koti ku rhumela switsundzuxo swa ku susumeta ku kondza u pfumelela switiviso eka swiyimiso swa foni ya wena.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.ve: Beautonomi a i koni u rumela nḓivhadzo dza u sukumedza u swikela ni tshi tendela nḓivhadzo kha zwishumiswa zwa founu yaṋu.
Beautonomi can’t send push alerts until.ss: Beautonomi ayikhoni kutfumela tecwayiso te-push uze uvumele tatiso kumasethingi efoni yakho.

You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.af: Jy moet ten minste 13 wees om Beautonomi te gebruik. Identiteitsverifikasie en uitbetalings vereis 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.zu: Kufanele okungenani ube neminyaka eyi-13 ukusebenzisa Beautonomi. Ukuqinisekisa ubuwena nezinkokhelo kudinga okungu-18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.xh: Kufuneka ube neminyaka eli-13 ubuncinci ukusebenzisa Beautonomi. Ukuqinisekiswa kwesazisi kunye neentlawulo zifuna i-18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.st: O tlameha ho ba le bonyane lilemo tse 13 ho sebelisa Beautonomi. Netefatso ea boitsebiso le litefo li hloka 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.nso: O swanetše go ba bonnyane bja mengwaga ye 13 go šomiša Beautonomi. Netefatšo ya boitšhupo le ditefelo di nyaka 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.tn: O tshwanetse go nna bonnye dingwaga di le 13 go dirisa Beautonomi. Netefatso ya boitshupo le dituelo di tlhoka 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.ts: U fanele ku va na kwalomu ka 13 ku tirhisa Beautonomi. Ku tiyisisiwa ka vutitivisi na ku hakela swi lava 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.ve: U fanela u vha na miṅwaha i si fhasi ha 13 u itela u shumisa Beautonomi. U khwaṱhisedzwa ha vhuṱanzi na u badela zwi ṱoḓa 18+.
You must be at least 13 to use Beautonom.ss: Kufanele ube neminyaka lengu-13 kute usebentise Beautonomi. Kucinisekisa bunikati kanye nekukhokha kudzinga 18+.

You can still permanently delete your ac.ts: U nga ha susa akhawunti ya wena hi laha ku nga heriki laha hansi loko u lava leswaku data hinkwayo ya munhu hi xiyexe yi susiwa.
You can still permanently delete your ac.ve: Ni nga kha ḓi phumula akhaunthu yaṋu lwa tshoṱhe afho fhasi arali ni tshi ṱoḓa uri data yoṱhe ya muthu nga eṱhe i bviswe.
You can still permanently delete your ac.ss: Usengacisha unomphela i-akhawunti yakho lengentansi nangabe ufuna kutsi yonkhe idatha yakho isuswe.

Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.af: Tik 'n kategorie om uit te vou of in te vou. Voeg een of meer dienste vir jouself of jou groep by.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.zu: Thepha isigaba ukuze unwebe noma ugoqe. Engeza isevisi eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwakho noma iqembu lakho.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.xh: Cofa udidi ukwandisa okanye ukuwa. Yongeza inkonzo enye okanye ngaphezulu kwakho okanye iqela lakho.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.st: Tlanya sehlopha ho holisa kapa ho putlama. Kenya tšebeletso e le 'ngoe kapa tse ngata bakeng sa hau kapa sehlopha sa hau.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.nso: Kgwatha legoro go katološa goba go phuhlama. Oketša tirelo e tee goba tše ntši tša gago goba sehlopha sa gago.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.tn: Konya setlhopha go se atolosa kgotsa go se phutlhamisa. Tsenya tirelo e le nngwe kgotsa go feta ya gago kgotsa ya setlhopha sa gago.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.ts: Khoma xiyenge ku ndlandlamuxa kumbe ku wisa. Engetelani vukorhokeri byin’we kumbe ku tlula bya wena kumbe ntlawa wa wena.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.ve: Kha vha dzhene kha khethekanyo u itela u engedza kana u fhungudza. Engedzani tshumelo nthihi kana nnzhi dza inwi kana tshigwada tshaṋu.
Tap a category to expand or collapse. Ad.ss: Thepha sigaba kute usikhulise nobe usibhidlite. Ngeta insizakalo yinye nobe ngetulu yakho nobe yelicembu lakho.

We couldn't charge your card. Update you.af: Ons kon nie jou kaart hef nie. Dateer jou betaalkaart op om jou {{planName}}-voordele te behou.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.zu: Asikwazanga ukukhokhisa ikhadi lakho. Buyekeza ikhadi lakho lokukhokha ukuze ugcine izinzuzo zakho {{planName}}.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.xh: Asikwazanga ukuhlawulisa ikhadi lakho. Hlaziya ikhadi lakho lentlawulo ukuze ugcine izibonelelo {{planName}} zakho.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.st: Ha rea ​​khona ho lefisa karete ea hau. Ntlafatsa karete ea hau ea tefo ho boloka melemo ea {{planName}}.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.nso: Re be re sa kgone go lefiša karata ya gago. Mpshafatša karata ya gago ya tefelo go boloka dikholego tša gago tša {{planName}}.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.tn: Ga re a kgona go duedisa karata ya gago. Ntšhwafatsa karata ya gago ya tuelo go boloka dipoelo tsa gago tsa {{planName}}.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.ts: A hi swi kotanga ku hakela khadi ra wena. Pfuxeta khadi ra wena ro hakela ku hlayisa mimbuyelo ya wena {{planName}}.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.ve: Ro vha ri sa koni u badelisa garaṱa yaṋu. Kha vha khwinise garaṱa yavho ya mbadelo u itela u vhulunga mbuelo dzavho dza {{planName}}.
We couldn't charge your card. Update you.ss: Asikwatanga kukhokhisa likhadi lakho. Vuselela likhadi lakho lekukhokha kute ugcine tinzuzo takho {{planName}}.

Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.af: Voeg 'n betaalkaart by Betaalmetodes en keer dan terug hierheen om jou lidmaatskapfakturering op te dateer.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.zu: Engeza ikhadi lokukhokha Ezindleleni Zokukhokha, bese ubuyela lapha ukuze ubuyekeze inkokhelo yakho yobulungu.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.xh: Yongeza ikhadi lentlawulo kwiiNdlela zokuHlawula, emva koko ubuyele apha ukuze uhlaziye ubulungu bakho.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.st: Kenya karete ea ho lefa ka Mekhoa ea ho Tefo, ebe u khutlela mona ho ntlafatsa tefiso ea hau ea litho.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.nso: Oketša karata ya tefelo go Mekgwa ya Tefo, ke moka o boele mo go mpshafatša tefo ya gago ya boleloko.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.tn: Tsenya karata ya tuelo mo Mekgweng ya Tuelo, o bo o boela fano go tlhabolola sekoloto sa gago sa botokololo.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.ts: Engetelani khadi ro hakela eka Tindlela to Hakela, kutani u tlhelela laha ku pfuxeta xibalo xa wena xa xirho.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.ve: Engedzani garaṱa ya mbadelo kha Nḓila dza Mbadelo, nga murahu ni vhuyelele fhano u itela u khwinisa mbadelo yaṋu ya muraḓo.
Add a payment card in Payment Methods, t.ss: Ngeta likhadi lekukhokha ku Tindlela Tekukhokha, bese ubuyela lapha kute uvuselele imali yakho yekuba lilunga.

Your account will be disabled immediatel.af: Jou rekening sal onmiddellik gedeaktiveer word. Jy kan enige tyd heraktiveer deur weer aan te meld.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.zu: I-akhawunti yakho izokhutshazwa ngokushesha. Ungaphinda wenze kusebenze noma nini ngokungena futhi.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.xh: Iakhawunti yakho iya kuvalwa ngoko nangoko. Ungaphinda usebenze nangaliphi na ixesha ngokungena kwakhona.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.st: Ak'haonte ea hau e tla koaloa hanghang. O ka bula hape neng kapa neng ka ho kena hape.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.nso: Akhaonto ya gago e tla šitišwa ka pela. O ka tsenya tirišong gape nako efe goba efe ka go tsena gape.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.tn: Akhaonto ya gago e tla thibelwa ka bonako. O ka simolola gape nako nngwe le nngwe ka go tsena gape.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.ts: Akhawunti ya wena yi ta pfariwa hi ku hatlisa. U nga ha tlhela u tirha nkarhi wihi na wihi hi ku nghena nakambe.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.ve: Account yanu i do thivhelwa nga u tavhanya. Ni nga dovha na shuma tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga u dzhena hafhu.
Your account will be disabled immediatel.ss: I-akhawunti yakho itawucinywa ngekushesha. Ungaphindze uvule noma nini ngekuphindze ungene ngemvume.

Finish payment in the browser. Once done.af: Voltooi betaling in die blaaier. Sodra jy klaar is, gaan na Rekening → Lidmaatskap om jou nuwe plan te sien.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.zu: Qedela ukukhokha esipheqululini. Uma usuqedile, hamba ku-Akhawunti → Ubulungu ukuze ubone uhlelo lwakho olusha.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.xh: Gqibezela intlawulo kwisikhangeli. Nje ukuba ugqibile, yiya kwiAkhawunti → Ubulungu ukuze ubone isicwangciso sakho esitsha.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.st: Qetella ho lefa sebatli. Ha u se u qetile, e-ea ho Account → Botho ho bona moralo oa hau o mocha.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.nso: Qeta tefo ka sephephediši. Ge o šetše o dirile, eya go Akhaonto → Boleloko go bona leano la gago le lefsa.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.tn: Fetsa tuelo mo sebatling. Fa o sena go fetsa, ya kwa Akhaontong → Botokololo go bona thulaganyo ya gago e ntšha.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.ts: Hetisa ku hakela eka browser. Loko se u endlile, nghena eka Account → Membership ku vona pulani ya wena leyintshwa.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.ve: U fhedza u badela kha browser. Musi no no fhedza, iyani kha Akhaunthu → Muraḓo u itela u vhona pulane yaṋu ntswa.
Finish payment in the browser. Once done.ss: Cedzela kukhokha kusiphequluli. Uma sewucedzile, iya ku-Akhawunti → Bulunga kute ubone luhlelo lwakho lolusha.

Choose where your appointment happens. S.af: Kies waar jou afspraak plaasvind. Dienspryse op die volgende stap weerspieël hierdie keuse.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.zu: Khetha ukuthi i-aphoyintimenti yakho yenzeka kuphi. Izintengo zesevisi esinyathelweni esilandelayo zibonisa le nketho.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.xh: Khetha apho idinga lakho lenzeka khona. Amaxabiso enkonzo kwinyathelo elilandelayo abonisa olu khetho.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.st: Khetha moo kopano ea hau e tla etsahala teng. Litheko tsa litšebeletso mohatong o latelang li bontša khetho ena.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.nso: Kgetha moo peeletšo ya gago e diregago gona. Ditheko tša tirelo mo mogatong wo o latelago di bontšha kgetho ye.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.tn: Tlhopha gore peelanonako ya gago e diragala kae. Ditlhwatlhwa tsa tirelo mo legatong le le latelang di bontsha tlhopho eno.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.ts: Hlawula laha ku hlanganyela ka wena ku endlekaka kona. Minxavo ya vukorhokeri eka goza leri landzelaka yi kombisa ku hlawula loku.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.ve: Khethani hune u vhewa haṋu ha itea hone. Mitengo ya tshumelo kha vhukando vhu tevhelaho i sumbedza khetho iyi.
Choose where your appointment happens. S.ss: Khetsa lapho kuhlangana kwakho kwenteka khona. Intsengo yetinsita esinyatselweni lesilandzelako ikhombisa lokukhetsa.

If you completed payment, it may take a.af: As jy betaling voltooi het, kan dit 'n paar oomblikke neem om te bevestig. Herlaai hierdie bestelling binnekort.
If you completed payment, it may take a.zu: Uma uqedele ukukhokha, kungase kuthathe isikhashana ukuqinisekisa. Vuselela leli oda maduze.
If you completed payment, it may take a.xh: Ukuba uyigqibile intlawulo, kungathatha imizuzu embalwa ukuqinisekisa. Hlaziya le oda kungekudala.
If you completed payment, it may take a.st: Haeba u qetile ho lefa, ho ka nka nakoana ho netefatsa. Hlahisa odara ena haufinyane.
If you completed payment, it may take a.nso: Ge e ba o phethile tefo, go ka tšea metsotswana e sego kae go tiišetša. Hlabolla taelo ye kapejana.
If you completed payment, it may take a.tn: Fa e le gore o feditse go duela, go ka nna ga tsaya metsotsonyana go tlhomamisa. Ntšhwafatsa otara eno mo nakong e khutshwane.
If you completed payment, it may take a.ts: Loko u hetile ku hakela, swi nga ha teka nkarhinyana ku tiyisisa. Pfuxeta oda leyi ku nga ri khale.
If you completed payment, it may take a.ve: Arali vho fhedza u badela, zwi nga dzhia tshifhinga tshi si gathi u khwaṱhisedza. Kha vha vusuludze oda iyi hu si kale.
If you completed payment, it may take a.ss: Uma ngabe sewucedzile kukhokha, kungase kutsatse sikhatsi lesincane kucinisekisa. Vuselela le-oda masinyane.

Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.nso: Šomiša Google Khalendara, Outlook mo wepeng, goba kgetho ya faele ya almanaka (.ics) skrineng se.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.tn: Dirisa Google Khalentara, Outlook mo webong, kgotsa tlhopho ya faele ya khalentara (.ics) mo sekirining seno.

Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.ve: Shumisani Google Khalenda, Outlook kha web, kana khetho ya faila ya khalenda (.ics) kha tshikirini itshi.
Use Google Calendar, Outlook on the web,.ss: Sebentisa Google Ikhalenda, i-Outlook kuwebhu, nobe inketho yefayela lekhalenda (.ics) kulesikrini.

This moves the entire group to a new dat.af: Dit skuif die hele groep na 'n nuwe datum en tyd. Beskikbaarheid word geverifieer wanneer jy stoor.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.zu: Lokhu kuyisa iqembu lonke edethini nasesikhathini esisha. Ukutholakala kuyaqinisekiswa uma ulondoloza.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.xh: Oku kuhambisa lonke iqela kumhla kunye nexesha elitsha. Ubukho buyaqinisekiswa xa ugcina.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.st: Sena se isa sehlopha sohle letsatsing le nako e ncha. Ho ba teng hoa netefatsoa ha o boloka.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.nso: Se se šuthišetša sehlopha ka moka go letšatšikgwedi le nako ye mpsha. Go hwetšagala go netefatšwa ge o boloka.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.tn: Seno se dira gore setlhopha sotlhe se ye kwa letlhang le nako e ntšha. Go nna teng go netefadiwa fa o boloka.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.ts: Leswi swi yisa ntlawa hinkwawo eka siku ni nkarhi lowuntshwa. Ku kumeka ka tiyisisiwa loko u hlayisa.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.ve: Hezwi zwi isa tshigwada tshoṱhe kha ḓuvha na tshifhinga zwiswa. U vha hone zwi khwaṱhisedzwa musi ni tshi vhulunga.
This moves the entire group to a new dat.ss: Loku kuhambisa lonkhe licembu liye elusuku nesikhatsi lesisha. Kutfolakala kuyacinisekiswa uma ugcina.

Add a shared time slot, service, team me.af: Voeg 'n gedeelde tydgleuf, diens, spanlid en aanvanklike deelnemers by met kalendertjeks.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.zu: Engeza isikhala sesikhathi esabelwe, isevisi, ilungu leqembu, nabahlanganyeli bokuqala ngokuhlolwa kwekhalenda.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.xh: Yongeza isithuba sexesha ekwabelwana ngalo, inkonzo, ilungu leqela, kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba bokuqala ngokutshekishwa kwekhalenda.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.st: Kenya nako e arolelanoang, tšebeletso, setho sa sehlopha, le bankakarolo ba pele ka licheke tsa almanaka.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.nso: Oketša sebaka sa nako ye e abelanwago, tirelo, setho sa sehlopha, le batšwasehlabelo ba mathomo ka ditlhahlobo tša almanaka.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.tn: Tsenya nako e e tlhakanetsweng, tirelo, leloko la setlhopha, le batsayakarolo ba ntlha ba ba nang le ditšheke tsa khalentara.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.ts: Engetelani nkarhi lowu avelaniwa, vukorhokeri, xirho xa ntlawa, na vatekaxiave vo sungula hi ku kamberiwa ka khalendara.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.ve: Kha vha engedze tshifhinga tsho kovhekanywaho, tshumelo, muraḓo wa tshigwada, na vhaṱanganedzi vha u thoma vha re na tsedzuluso dza khalenda.
Add a shared time slot, service, team me.ss: Ngeta sikhatsi lesabelwana ngaso, insizakalo, lilunga lelicembu, kanye nebahlanganyeli bekucala ngekuhlola ikhalenda.

Create a group session for bridal partie.af: Skep 'n groepsessie vir bruidspartytjies, geleenthede, gesinne of gedeelde diensafsprake.
Create a group session for bridal partie.zu: Dala iseshini yeqembu yamaphathi omakoti, imicimbi, imindeni, noma ama-aphoyintimenti esevisi okwabelwana ngawo.
Create a group session for bridal partie.xh: Yenza iseshoni yeqela ukwenzela amaqela omtshato, imisitho, iintsapho, okanye ukuqeshwa kwenkonzo ekwabelwana ngayo.
Create a group session for bridal partie.st: Theha sehlopha bakeng sa meketjana ea banyaluoa, liketsahalo, malapa, kapa litumellano tsa litšebeletso tse arolelanoang.
Create a group session for bridal partie.nso: Hlama seboka sa sehlopha sa menyanya ya banyadi, ditiragalo, malapa, goba dipeelano tša tirelo tše di abelanwago.
Create a group session for bridal partie.tn: Tlhama thulaganyo ya setlhopha ya meletlo ya banyadi, ditiragalo, malapa, kgotsa dipeelanonako tsa tirelo tse di tlhakanetsweng.
Create a group session for bridal partie.ts: Endla xiyenge xa ​​ntlawa xa minkhuvo ya vukati, swiendlakalo, mindyangu, kumbe ku hlanganyela ka ntirho lowu avelaniwa.
Create a group session for bridal partie.ve: Kha vha sike sesheni ya tshigwada ya maḓikiṱa a vhafumakadzi, zwiitea, miṱa, kana u tholwa ha tshumelo yo ṱanganelanaho.
Create a group session for bridal partie.ss: Dala seshini yelicembu yemaphathi emakoti, imicimbi, imindeni, noma ema-aphoyintimenti enkonzo lehlanganyelwe.

The notification could not be delivered..zu: Isaziso asikwazanga ukulethwa. Hlola imininingwane yokuxhumana yekhasimende bese uzama futhi.
The notification could not be delivered..xh: Isaziso asikwazanga kuhanjiswa. Jonga iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano zomthengi kwaye uzame kwakhona.
The notification could not be delivered..st: Tsebiso ha e ea fihla. Sheba lintlha tsa puisano tsa moreki 'me u leke hape.
The notification could not be delivered..nso: Tsebišo e be e sa kgone go tlišwa. Lekola dintlha tša kgokagano ya moreki gomme o leke gape.
The notification could not be delivered..tn: Kitsiso ga e a kgona go gorosiwa. Tlhola dintlha tsa kgolagano tsa khasetomara mme o leke gape.
The notification could not be delivered..ts: Xitiviso lexi a xi swi kotanga ku yisiwa. Languta vuxokoxoko bya vuhlanganisi bya muxavi ivi u ringeta nakambe.
The notification could not be delivered..ve: Nḓivhadzo a yo ngo kona u swikiswa. Kha vha sedze zwidodombedzwa zwa vhukwamani zwa khasiṱama vha lingedze hafhu.
The notification could not be delivered..ss: Lesatiso asizange sikhone kuhanjiswa. Hlola imininingwane yekuchumana yekhasimende bese uyazama futsi.

Inherited days follow your location oper.af: Oorgeërfde dae volg jou ligging se werksure. Voeg 'n weeklikse skof by om gepasmaakte ure in te stel.
Inherited days follow your location oper.zu: Izinsuku ezizuzwe njengefa zilandela amahora okusebenza wendawo yakho. Engeza ukushintsha kwamasonto onke ukuze usethe amahora angokwezifiso.
Inherited days follow your location oper.xh: Iintsuku zelifa zilandela iiyure zokusebenza kwendawo yakho. Yongeza ishifti yeveki ukuseta iiyure eziqhelekileyo.
Inherited days follow your location oper.st: Matsatsi a futsitsoeng a latela lihora tsa ts'ebetso ea sebaka sa hau. Kenya phetoho ea beke le beke ho beha lihora tse ikhethileng.
Inherited days follow your location oper.nso: Matšatši a leabela a latela diiri tša gago tša go šoma tša lefelo. Oketša tšhifiti ya beke le beke go beakanya diiri tša tlwaelo.
Inherited days follow your location oper.tn: Malatsi a a ruilweng a latela diura tsa tiro tsa lefelo la gago. Tsenya shifiti ya beke le beke go seta diura tse di tlwaelegileng.
Inherited days follow your location oper.ts: Masiku ya ndzhaka ya landzela tiawara ta ntirho wa ndhawu ya wena. Engetelani ku cinca ka vhiki na vhiki ku veka tiawara ta ntolovelo.
Inherited days follow your location oper.ve: Maḓuvha a ifa a tevhela awara dza u shuma dza fhethu haṋu. Engedza tshifhinga tsha vhege iṅwe na iṅwe u itela u vhea awara dzo ḓoweleaho.
Inherited days follow your location oper.ss: Emalanga latsatfwa njengelifa alandzela emahora ekusebenta endzaweni yakho. Ngeta ishifu yeliviki kute usethe emahora lakhetsiwe.

Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.zu: Ithiphu: Ngezintengo eziningi kusevisi eyodwa, khetha Okuyisisekelo futhi usebenzise izinketho zokubhukha ngezansi esikhundleni salokho.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.xh: Ingcebiso: Ngamaxabiso amaninzi kwinkonzo enye, khetha iSiseko kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokubhukisha ezingezantsi endaweni yoko.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.st: Keletso: Bakeng sa litheko tse ngata tšebeletsong e le 'ngoe, khetha Ntho ea Motheo 'me u sebelise mekhoa ea ho boloka sebaka ka tlase.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.nso: Keletšo: Bakeng sa ditheko tše ntši tirelong e tee, kgetha Motheo gomme o šomiše dikgetho tša go beakanya ka mo tlase go e na le moo.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.tn: Tlhabo-botlhale: Go bona ditlhwatlhwa tse dintsi mo tirelong e le nngwe, tlhopha Motheo mme o dirise ditlhopho tsa go buka tse di fa tlase boemong jwa seo.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.ts: Xitsundzuxo: Ku kuma minxavo yo tala eka vukorhokeri byin’we, hlawula Basic ivi u tirhisa tindlela to bukuta leti nga laha hansi ematshan’wini ya sweswo.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.ve: Tsivhudzo: Kha mitengo minzhi kha tshumelo nthihi, khethani Basic nahone ni shumise khetho dza u buka dzi re afho fhasi nṱhani hazwo.
Tip: For multiple prices on one service,.ss: Lusito: Kute utfole emanani lamanyenti enkonzweni yinye, khetsa Sisekelo bese usebentisa tindlela tekubhuka letingephansi esikhundleni saloko.

Set the price and duration for this vari.af: Stel die prys en duur vir hierdie variant. Dit verskyn onder die ouerdiens by bespreking.
Set the price and duration for this vari.zu: Setha intengo nobude besikhathi salokhu okuhlukile. Ivela ngaphansi kwesevisi yomzali ekubhukheni.
Set the price and duration for this vari.xh: Seta ixabiso kunye nobude balo mahluko. Ibonakala phantsi kwenkonzo yabazali ekubhukisheni.
Set the price and duration for this vari.st: Beha theko le nako ea mofuta ona. E hlaha tlas'a litšebeletso tsa motsoali nakong ea ho bhuka.
Set the price and duration for this vari.nso: Beha theko le nako bakeng sa fapaneng ena. E tšwelela ka fase ga tirelo ya motswadi ge o beakanya.
Set the price and duration for this vari.tn: Seta tlhwatlhwa le nako ya mofuta ono. E tlhagelela ka fa tlase ga tirelo ya motsadi fa o dira dipeeletso.
Set the price and duration for this vari.ts: Seta nxavo na nkarhi wa muxaka lowu. Yi humelela ehansi ka vukorhokeri bya vatswari loko u bukuta.
Set the price and duration for this vari.ve: Setha mutengo na tshifhinga tsha heyi variant. I vhonala fhasi ha tshumelo ya mubebi musi u tshi khou buka.
Set the price and duration for this vari.ss: Setha intengo kanye nesikhatsi sale variant. Kuvela ngaphansi kwenkonzo yemtali ngesikhatsi ubhukha.

When set, the campaign is saved as sched.af: Wanneer dit gestel is, word die veldtog gestoor soos geskeduleer; tik Stuur op die lys om af te lewer (dieselfde as web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.zu: Uma usethiwe, umkhankaso ugcinwa njengoba uhleliwe; thepha okuthi Thumela ohlwini ukuze ulethe (kufana newebhu).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.xh: Xa isetiwe, iphulo ligcinwa njengoko kucwangcisiwe; cinezela Thumela kuluhlu ukuzisa (kufana newebhu).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.st: Ha e behiloe, lets'olo le bolokoa joalo ka ha le reriloe; tlanya Romela lenaneng le tlang ho tsamaisoa (ho tšoana le tepo).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.nso: Ge e beakantšwe, lesolo le bolokwa bjalo ka ge le rulagantšwe; klika Romela lenaneong la go tliša (go swana le wepe).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.tn: Fa e setilwe, letsholo le bolokwa jaaka go rulagantswe; tobetsa Romela mo lenaaneng go romela (go tshwana le webo).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.ts: Loko yi vekiwile, tsima ri hlayisiwa hilaha ri hleriweke hakona; khoma Rhumela eka nxaxamelo ku yisa (swi fana na webu).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.ve: Musi ḽo vhewa, fulo ḽi vhulungwa sa zwe ḽa dzudzanywa zwone; kha vha ṱoḓe Send kha mutevhe wa u ḓisa (zwi fana na web).
When set, the campaign is saved as sched.ss: Uma usethwe, umkhankhaso ugcinwa njengobe uhleliwe; thepha Tfumela eluhlwini lwekuletsa (kufana newebhu).

Search above, use your location, or drop.af: Soek hierbo, gebruik jou ligging, of los 'n speld. Gestoorde adresse verskyn hier vir vinnige hergebruik.
Search above, use your location, or drop.zu: Sesha ngenhla, sebenzisa indawo yakho, noma ubeke iphinikhodi. Amakheli alondoloziwe avela lapha ukuze aphinde asetshenziswe ngokushesha.
Search above, use your location, or drop.xh: Khangela ngasentla, sebenzisa indawo okuyo, okanye ulahle iphini. Iidilesi ezigciniweyo zivela apha ukuze ziphinde zisetyenziswe ngokukhawuleza.
Search above, use your location, or drop.st: Batla ka holimo, sebelisa sebaka seo u leng ho sona, kapa u tlohele phini. Liaterese tse bolokiloeng li hlaha mona bakeng sa ho sebelisoa hape kapele.
Search above, use your location, or drop.nso: Batla ka godimo, šomiša lefelo la gago, goba o lahlele pini. Diaterese tše di bolokilwego di tšwelela mo bakeng sa go dirišwa gape ka pela.
Search above, use your location, or drop.tn: Batla fa godimo, dirisa lefelo la gago, kgotsa latlhela pin. Diaterese tse di bolokilweng di tlhagelela fano gore di dirisiwe gape ka bonako.
Search above, use your location, or drop.ts: Lavisisa laha henhla, tirhisa ndhawu ya wena, kutani u hoxa pini. Tiadirese leti hlayisiweke ti humelela laha leswaku ti tirhisiwa nakambe hi ku hatlisa.
Search above, use your location, or drop.ve: Setshani afho ntha, shumisani vhupo hanu, kana ni pose pini. Ḓiresi dzo vhulungwaho dzi vhonala hafha u itela u shumiswa hafhu nga u ṱavhanya.
Search above, use your location, or drop.ss: Sesha ngenhla, sebentisa indzawo yakho, noma ulahle iphini. Emakheli lagciniwe avela lapha kute aphindze asetjentiswe ngekushesha.

Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.zu: Iwindi lokubuyisela (izinsuku ezingu-{{days}}) selidlulile. Ukuze uthole usizo, vula Iphrofayela → Isikhungo sosizo → Ithikithi elisha.
Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.xh: Ifestile yokubuya (iintsuku {{days}}) idlulile. Ngoncedo, vula iProfayili → Iziko loNcedo → Itikiti elitsha.
Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.st: Fesetere ea ho khutla (matsatsi a {{days}}) e fetile. Ho fumana thuso, bula Profaele → Setsi sa thuso → Tekete e ncha.
Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.nso: Lefasetere la go boela morago (matšatši a{{days}}) le fetile. Bakeng sa thušo, bula Profaele → Setsi sa thušo → Thekethe ye mpsha.
Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.tn: Letlhabaphefo la go boela (malatsi a {{days}}) le fetile. Go bona thuso, bula Porofaele → Lefelo la thuso → Thekete e ntšhwa.
Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.ts: Fasitere ro vuyela ({{days}} masiku) ri hundzile. Ku kuma mpfuneto, pfula Profayile → Senthara ya mpfuneto → Thikithi lerintshwa.
Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.ve: Fasitere ḽa u vhuisa ({{days}} maḓuvha) ḽo fhira. U itela thuso, vulani Phurofaili → Senthara ya thuso → Thikhithi ntswa.
Return window ({{days}} days) has passed.ss: Ifasitela lekubuya ({{days}} emalanga) selidlulile. Kute utfole lusito, vula Iphrofayili → Sikhungo selusito → Lithikithi lelisha.

Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.af: Tik Kyk om 'n opgelaaide dokument oop te maak. Outomatiese kontroles sal dalk nie 'n aflaaibare lêer insluit nie.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.zu: Thepha okuthi Buka ukuze uvule idokhumenti elayishiwe. Ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo kungase kungafaki ifayela elilandekayo.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.xh: Cofa Jonga ukuze uvule uxwebhu olulayishiweyo. Iitshekhi ezizenzekelayo zisenokungabandakanyi ifayile ekhutshelwayo.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.st: Tlanya Sheba ho bula tokomane e kentsoeng. Licheke tsa othomathiki li kanna tsa se kenyeletse faele e ka khoasolloang.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.nso: Klika Tebelelego go bula tokumente ye e tsentšwego. Ditšheke tša go itiriša di ka no se akaretše faele yeo e ka taoneloutšwago.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.tn: Konya Tebo go bula tokomane e e laisitsweng. Ditshekatsheko tse di itirisang di ka nna tsa se ka tsa akaretsa faele e e ka laisololwang.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.ts: Thepha View ku pfula tsalwa leri layichiweke. Ticheke ta otomatiki ti nga ha va ti nga katsi fayili leyi nga dawunilodiwaka.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.ve: Kha vha dzhene kha View u itela u vula ḽiṅwalo ḽo dzheniswaho. U ṱola ho ḓiimisaho nga hoṱhe hu nga kha ḓi sa katela faela ine ya nga dawuniḽoudiwa.
Tap View to open an uploaded document. A.ss: Thepha Buka kute uvule idokhumenti lelayishiwe. Kuhlola lokuzenzakalelayo kungenteka kungafaki lifayela lelilandvwako.

Use the person's @handle from their prof.af: Gebruik die persoon se @handle vanaf hul profiel, of hul gebruikers-ID as jy dit van 'n bespreking het.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.zu: Sebenzisa i-@handle yomuntu kuphrofayela yakhe, noma i-ID yakhe yomsebenzisi uma unayo endaweni oyibhukile.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.xh: Sebenzisa i-@handle yomntu kwiprofayile yakhe, okanye i-ID yakhe yomsebenzisi ukuba unayo kwindawo ebhukisiweyo.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.st: Sebelisa @handle ea motho ho tsoa profilaneng ea hae, kapa ID ea mosebelisi haeba u e fumane ho tsoa bukeng.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.nso: Diriša @handle ya motho yoo go tšwa go profaele ya gagwe, goba ID ya gagwe ya mosediriši ge o na le yona go tšwa go peeletšo.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.tn: Dirisa @handle ya motho go tswa mo porofaeleng ya gagwe, kgotsa ID ya gagwe ya modirisi fa e le gore o na le yone go tswa mo peeletso.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.ts: Tirhisa @handle ya munhu loyi kusuka eka profile ya yena, kumbe user ID ya yena loko uri na yona kusuka eka booking.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.ve: Shumisani @handle ya muthu ubva kha profile yawe, kana user ID yawe arali ni nayo ubva kha booking.
Use the person's @handle from their prof.ss: Sebentisa i-@handle yalomuntfu kusuka kuphrofayela yakhe, noma i-ID yakhe yemsebentisi uma unayo kusuka ekubhukheni.

Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.af: Voer die {{digits}}-syferkode in wat na jou foon gestuur is (geldig omtrent {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.zu: Faka ikhodi enamadijithi {{digits}} ethunyelwe ocingweni lwakho (ivumelekile mayelana {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.xh: Faka ikhowudi yedijithi {{digits}} ethunyelwe kwifowuni yakho (esebenzayo malunga {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.st: Kenya khoutu ea {{digits}} e rometsoeng fonong ea hau (e sebetsa ka {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.nso: Tsenya khoutu ya {{digits}} ya dinomoro yeo e rometšwego mo founong ya gago (e šoma mo e ka bago {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.tn: Tsenya khoutu ya dinomoro tsa {{digits}} e e rometsweng mo founong ya gago (e e dirang mo e ka nnang {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.ts: Nghenisa khodi ya {{digits}}-digit leyi rhumeriweke eka foni ya wena (yi tirha kwalomu ka {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.ve: Ṅwalani khoudu ya {{digits}}-dijithi yo rumelwaho kha founu yaṋu (ine ya shuma nga ha {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).
Enter the {{digits}}-digit code sent to.ss: Faka ikhodi lenetinombolo letingu-{{digits}} letfunyelwe elucingweni lwakho (isebenta cishe {{minutes}} {{minuteUnit}}).

The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.af: Die salon sal teen {{time}} bevestig. Indien nie, is hierdie tyd vrygestel en jy is {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.zu: Indawo yokucwala izinwele izoqinisekisa ngo {{time}}. Uma kungenjalo, lesi sikhathi siyakhululwa futhi u {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.xh: Isaluni iyakuqinisekisa ngo {{time}}. Ukuba akunjalo, eli xesha likhululiwe kwaye u {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.st: Salon e tla netefatsa ka {{time}}. Haeba ho se joalo, nako ena e lokollotsoe 'me u {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.nso: Salon e tla netefatsa ka {{time}}. Ge e ba go se bjalo, nako ye e a lokollwa gomme o {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.tn: Salon e tla netefatsa ka {{time}}. Fa go sa nna jalo, nako eno e a gololwa mme o {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.ts: Salon yi ta tiyisisa hi {{time}}. Loko swi nga ri tano, nkarhi lowu wu ntshunxiwile ivi u {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.ve: Salon i ḓo khwaṱhisedza nga {{time}}. Arali zwi songo ralo, tshifhinga hetshi tsho vhofhololwa nahone u {{refundLine}}.
The salon will confirm by {{time}}. If n.ss: The salon will confirm by {{time}}. Uma kungenjalo, lesikhatsi siyakhululwa futsi u {{refundLine}}.

Campaigns send through your own integrat.af: Veldtogte stuur deur jou eie integrasies, so Beautonomi hef nie bemarkingskrediete nie.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.zu: Imikhankaso ithumela ngokuhlanganiswa kwakho, ukuze Beautonomi ingakhokhisi amakhredithi okuthengisa.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.xh: Amaphulo athumela ngokudityaniswa kwakho, ngoko ke Beautonomi ayibizi khredithi zentengiso.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.st: Masolo a romelloa ka likhokahanyo tsa hau, kahoo Beautonomi ha e lefise likalimo tsa ho bapatsa.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.nso: Masolo a romela ka dikopanyo tša gago, ka fao Beautonomi ga e lefiše dikrediti tša papatšo.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.tn: Matsholo a romela ka dikopano tsa gago, ka jalo Beautonomi ga e duedise dikrediti tsa papatso.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.ts: Matshalatshala ya rhumela hi ku tirhisa swihlanganisi swa wena, kutani Beautonomi a yi hakeli swikweleti swa vuxavisi.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.ve: Mafulo a rumela nga kha u ṱanganya haṋu, ngauralo Beautonomi a i badelisi zwikolodo zwa u maketa.
Campaigns send through your own integrat.ss: Imikhankhaso itfumela ngekuhlanganiswa kwakho, ngako-ke Beautonomi ayikhokhisi emakhredithi ekumaketha.

No product order was linked yet. If prod.af: Geen produkbestelling is nog gekoppel nie. As produkte op hierdie besoek is, probeer weer of kontak steundiens.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.zu: Alikho i-oda lomkhiqizo elixhunywe okwamanje. Uma imikhiqizo ikulokhu kuvakasha, zama futhi noma uthinte abosekelo.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.xh: Akukho mveliso idityanisiweyo okwangoku. Ukuba iimveliso zikolu tyelelo, zama kwakhona okanye uqhagamshelane nenkxaso.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.st: Ha ho na odara ea sehlahisoa e hokahaneng. Haeba lihlahisoa li le teng ketelong ena, leka hape kapa ikopanye le ts'ehetso.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.nso: Ga go na taelo ya setšweletšwa yeo e kgokagantšwego go fihla ga bjale. Ge e le gore ditšweletšwa di ketelong ye, leka gape goba ikgokaganye le thekgo.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.tn: Ga go ise go golaganngwe otara ya sedirwa. Fa dikumo di le mo ketelong eno, leka gape kgotsa ikgolaganye le tshegetso.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.ts: Ku hava oda ya swikumiwa leyi hlanganisiweke ku fikela sweswi. Loko swikumiwa swi ri eka riendzo leri, ringeta nakambe kumbe u tihlanganisa na nseketelo.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.ve: A hu athu vha na oda ya tshibveledzwa yo ṱumanaho. Arali zwibveledzwa zwi kha madalo aya, lingedzani hafhu kana ni kwame thikhedzo.
No product order was linked yet. If prod.ss: Kute i-oda lemkhicito lelihlanganisiwe. Uma imikhicito ikulokuvakasha, zama futsi noma utsintse lusekelo.

You do not have permission to cancel thi.af: Jy het nie toestemming om hierdie bespreking te kanselleer nie. Vra 'n eienaar vir kansellasietoestemmings.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.zu: Awunayo imvume yokukhansela lokhu kubhuka. Cela umnikazi izimvume zokukhansela.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.xh: Awunayo imvume yokurhoxisa olu bhukisho. Cela imvume yokurhoxiswa kumnini.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.st: Ha u na tumello ea ho hlakola kopo ena. Kopa mong'a ntlo bakeng sa tumello ea ho hlakola.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.nso: Ga o na tumelelo ya go phumola peeletšo ye. Kgopela mong wa yona ditumelelo tša go phumola.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.tn: Ga o na tetla ya go khansela peeletso eno. Kopa mong wa yone ditetlelelo tsa go khansela.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.ts: A wu na mpfumelelo wo khansela buku leyi. Kombela n’wini wa yona ku kuma mpfumelelo wo khansela.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.ve: A vha na thendelo ya u khansela u buka uhu. Humbelani muṋe wa nnḓu thendelo ya u khansela.
You do not have permission to cancel thi.ss: Awunayo imvume yekukhansela lokubhukha. Cela umnikati imvume yekukhansela.

Add a serial number from your device lab.af: Voeg 'n reeksnommer van jou toesteletiket of aktiverings-e-pos by om kaartbetalings te begin neem.
Add a serial number from your device lab.zu: Engeza inombolo yomkhiqizo evela kulebula yedivayisi yakho noma i-imeyili yokwenza kusebenze ukuze uqale ukuthatha izinkokhelo zekhadi.
Add a serial number from your device lab.xh: Yongeza inombolo yesiriyali kwileyibhile yesixhobo sakho okanye i-imeyile yokuvula ukuze uqale ukuthatha iintlawulo zekhadi.
Add a serial number from your device lab.st: Kenya nomoro ea serial ho tsoa ho leibole ea sesebelisoa sa hau kapa lengolo-tsoibila la ho bula ho qala ho lefa likarete.
Add a serial number from your device lab.nso: Oketša nomoro ya tatelano go tšwa go leina la gago la sedirišwa goba imeile ya go tsenya tirišong go thoma go tšea ditefelo tša karata.
Add a serial number from your device lab.tn: Tsenya nomoro ya tatelano go tswa mo leiboleng ya sediriswa sa gago kgotsa imeile ya go tsenya tirisong go simolola go amogela dituelo tsa karata.
Add a serial number from your device lab.ts: Engetelani nomboro ya xirhendzevutani ku suka eka lebula ya xitirhisiwa xa wena kumbe imeyili yo tirhisa ku sungula ku teka tihakelo ta khadi.
Add a serial number from your device lab.ve: Kha vha engedze nomboro ya serial u bva kha lebula ya tshishumiswa tshavho kana imeiḽi ya u thoma u dzhia mbadelo dza garaṱa.
Add a serial number from your device lab.ss: Ngeta inombolo ye-serial kusuka kulebuli yedivayisi yakho noma i-imeyili yekusebenta kute ucale kutsatsa tinkhokhelo telikhadi.

Cancellation or refund affects stock and.af: Kansellasie of terugbetaling beïnvloed voorraad en uitbetalings. Gebruik wanneer daar 'n probleem met hierdie bestelling is.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.zu: Ukukhansela noma ukubuyiselwa imali kuthinta isitoko nezinkokhelo. Sebenzisa uma kunenkinga ngaleli oda.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.xh: Ukurhoxiswa okanye ukubuyiselwa imali kuchaphazela isitokhwe kunye neentlawulo. Sebenzisa xa kukho ingxaki ngalo myalelo.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.st: Ho hlakolwa kapa ho buseletswa ho ama setoko le ditefo. Sebelisa ha ho na le bothata ka taelo ena.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.nso: Go phumola goba go bušetša tšhelete go ama setoko le ditefelo. Diriša ge go na le bothata ka taelo ye.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.tn: Go khansela kgotsa go busediwa madi go ama setoko le dituelo. Dirisa fa go na le bothata ka otara eno.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.ts: Ku khansela kumbe ku tlheriseriwa mali swi khumba xitoko na ku hakela. Tirhisa loko ku ri na xiphiqo eka oda leyi.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.ve: U khansela kana u vhuisa tshelede zwi kwama tshitoko na mbadelo. Shumisani musi hu na thaidzo kha oda iyi.
Cancellation or refund affects stock and.ss: Kukhansela noma kubuyiselwa imali kuthinta sitoko kanye nekukhokha. Sebentisa uma kunenkinga ngale-oda.

The first appointment is on the calendar.af: Die eerste afspraak is op die kalender. Gebruik jou kaartmasjien om betaling te voltooi.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.zu: I-aphoyintimenti yokuqala isekhalendeni. Sebenzisa umshini wekhadi lakho ukuqedela inkokhelo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.xh: Idinga lokuqala likwikhalenda. Sebenzisa umatshini wekhadi lakho ukugqiba intlawulo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.st: Kopano ea pele e khalendareng. Sebelisa mochini oa karete ea hau ho phethela tefo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.nso: Peeletšo ya mathomo e almanaka. Diriša motšhene wa gago wa karata go phetha tefo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.tn: Peelanonako ya ntlha e mo khalentareng. Dirisa motšhini wa gago wa karata go feleletsa tuelo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.ts: Ku hlangana ko sungula ku le ka khalendara. Tirhisa muchini wa wena wa khadi ku hetisa ku hakela.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.ve: U vhewa ha u thoma hu kha khalenda. Shumisani mutshini waṋu wa garaṱa u itela u fhedza mbadelo.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.ss: Kubekwa kwekucala kusekhalendeni. Sebentisa umshini wakho welikhadi kute ucedzele kukhokha.{{extra}}

This row comes from weekly hours or loca.af: Hierdie ry kom van weeklikse ure of liggingsure af. Voeg 'n datumspesifieke verskuiwing by om dit te ignoreer.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.zu: Lo mugqa uvela emahoreni amasonto onke noma amahora endawo. Engeza i-shift eqondene nedethi ukuze uyikhiphe.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.xh: Lo mqolo uvela kwiiyure zeveki okanye iiyure zendawo. Yongeza ishifti yomhla othile ukuyibhala ngaphezulu.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.st: Mola ona o tsoa ho lihora tsa beke kapa lihora tsa sebaka. Kenya phetoho e ikhethileng ea letsatsi ho e hlakola.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.nso: Mothaladi wo o tšwa go diiri tša beke le beke goba diiri tša lefelo. Oketša phetogo ye e itšego ya letšatšikgwedi go e phaela ka thoko.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.tn: Mola ono o tswa mo diureng tsa beke le beke kgotsa mo diureng tsa lefelo. Tsenya phetogo e e rileng ya letlha go e phimola.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.ts: Layini leyi yi huma eka tiawara ta vhiki na vhiki kumbe tiawara ta ndhawu. Engetelani ku cinca loku kongomeke ka siku ku yi tlula.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.ve: Row iyi i bva kha awara dza vhege kana awara dza fhethu. Engedza tshifhinga tsho khetheaho tsha ḓuvha u itela u tshi fhirisa.
This row comes from weekly hours or loca.ss: Lomugca uvela emahoreni eliviki noma emahoreni endzawo. Ngeta shift lekhetsekile yelusuku kute uyicitse.

Recurring appointments require a plan th.af: Herhalende afsprake vereis 'n plan wat hierdie kenmerk insluit. Gradeer op onder Intekening.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.zu: Ama-aphoyintimenti aphindelelayo adinga uhlelo oluhlanganisa lesi sici. Thuthukisa ngaphansi kokubhaliselwe.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.xh: Ukuqeshwa okuphindaphindiweyo kufuna isicwangciso esibandakanya olu phawu. Phucula phantsi koBhaliso.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.st: Likopano tse etsahalang khafetsa li hloka moralo o kenyelletsang karolo ena. Ntlafatsa tlasa Ngoliso.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.nso: Dipeelo tšeo di ipoeletšago di nyaka leano leo le akaretšago tšobotsi ye. Ntlafatsa ka fase ga Peeletšo.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.tn: Dipeelanonako tse di ipoeletsang di tlhoka thulaganyo e e akaretsang karolo eno. Ntšhwafatsa ka fa tlase ga Peeletso.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.ts: Ku thoriwa loku phindha-phindhiwaka ku lava pulani leyi katsaka xivumbeko lexi. Ndlandlamuxa ehansi ka Xikhokhelo.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.ve: U ṱangana ha vhathu lunzhi-lunzhi zwi ṱoḓa pulane ine ya katela tshenetshi tshipiḓa. U khwinisa fhasi ha U Ḓiṅwalisa.
Recurring appointments require a plan th.ss: Kubekwa lokuphindzaphindziwe kudzinga luhlelo lolufaka ekhatsi lesici. Tfutfukisa ngaphansi kwekubhalisa.

Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.af: Soek, plaas 'n speld op die kaart of gebruik huidige ligging – wysig dan die lyne hieronder indien nodig.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.zu: Sesha, beka iphinikhodi kumephu, noma sebenzisa indawo yamanje — bese uhlela imigqa engezansi uma kudingeka.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.xh: Khangela, ulahle iphini kwimephu, okanye sebenzisa indawo yangoku — emva koko uhlele imigca engezantsi ukuba iyafuneka.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.st: Batla, beha phini 'mapeng, kapa sebelisa sebaka sa hajoale - ebe u hlophisa mela e ka tlase ha ho hlokahala.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.nso: Batla, lahlela pini mmapeng, goba o šomiše lefelo la bjale — ke moka o rulaganye mela ye e lego ka mo tlase ge go nyakega.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.tn: Batla, latlhela pine mo mmapeng, kgotsa dirisa lefelo la ga jaana — o bo o tseleganya mela e e fa tlase fa go tlhokega.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.ts: Secha, hoxa pini emepeni, kumbe u tirhisa ndhawu ya sweswi — kutani u hlela milayeni leyi nga laha hansi loko swi laveka.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.ve: Setshani, posani pini kha mapa, kana ni shumise fhethu ha zwino — nga murahu ni dzudzanye mitevhe i re afho fhasi arali zwi tshi ṱoḓea.
Search, drop a pin on the map, or use cu.ss: Sesha, wisa iphini ebalazweni, noma usebentise indzawo lekhona nyalo — bese uhlela imigca lengentansi uma kudzingeka.

Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.af: Standaard SA VAT koers is 15%. Dit word outomaties op alle diens- en produkpryse toegepas.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.zu: Izinga le-Standard SA VAT liyi-15%. Lokhu kusetshenziswa ngokuzenzakalela kuzo zonke izintengo zesevisi nemikhiqizo.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.xh: Umgangatho woMzantsi Afrika VAT umlinganiselo yi 15%. Oku kusetyenziswa ngokuzenzekelayo kuyo yonke inkonzo kunye namaxabiso emveliso.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.st: Standard SA VAT sekhahla ke 15%. Sena se sebelisoa ka bohona ho litheko tsohle tsa litšebeletso le lihlahisoa.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.nso: Sekhahla sa maemo a SA VAT ke 15%. Se se dirišwa ka go itiriša go ditheko ka moka tša tirelo le ditšweletšwa.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.tn: Seelo se se tlwaelegileng sa SA VAT ke 15%. Se se dirisiwa ka go itirisa mo ditlhwatlhweng tsotlhe tsa tirelo le tsa dikumo.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.ts: Mpimo wa SA VAT wa ntolovelo i 15%. Leswi swi tirhisiwa hi ku tisungulela eka minxavo hinkwayo ya vukorhokeri na swikumiwa.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.ve: Tshikalo tsha SA VAT tsha maimo ndi 15%. Hezwi zwi shuma nga vhuḓiitisi kha mitengo yoṱhe ya tshumelo na zwibveledzwa.
Standard SA VAT rate is 15%. This is aut.ss: Izinga lelijwayelekile le-SA VAT lingu-15%. Loku kusebenta ngekuzenzakalela kuwo onkhe emanani etinsita kanye nemkhicito.

Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.af: Behou hierdie spanwerk, of maak jou eie Beautonomi besigheid oop. Jy kan enige tyd tussen hulle wissel.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.zu: Gcina lo msebenzi weqembu, noma uvule elakho Beautonomi ibhizinisi. Ungashintsha phakathi kwazo noma nini.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.xh: Gcina eli qela lomsebenzi, okanye uvule elakho ishishini Beautonomi. Ungatshintsha phakathi kwabo nanini na.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.st: Boloka mosebetsi oa sehlopha sena, kapa bula khoebo ea hau Beautonomi. U ka fetola pakeng tsa tsona nako efe kapa efe.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.nso: Boloka mošomo wo wa sehlopha, goba o bule kgwebo ya gago Beautonomi. O ka fetola magareng ga bona nako efe goba efe.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.tn: Boloka tiro eno ya setlhopha, kgotsa o bule kgwebo ya gago ya Beautonomi. O ka fetoga fa gare ga tsone nako nngwe le nngwe.
Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.ts: Hlayisa ntirho lowu wa xipano, kutani u pfula bindzu ra wena Beautonomi. U nga cinca-cinca exikarhi ka tona nkarhi wun’wana ni wun’wana.

Keep this team job, or open your own Bea.ss: Gcina lomsebenti welicembu, noma uvule ibhizinisi lakho Beautonomi. Ungashintja emkhatsini wabo noma nini.

How you compensate your staff or contrac.af: Hoe jy jou personeel of kontrakteurs vergoed. U kan dit enige tyd in Payroll-instellings verfyn.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.zu: Unxephezela kanjani abasebenzi bakho noma osonkontileka. Ungakwazi ukucwenga lokhu kuzilungiselelo ze-Payroll noma nini.

How you compensate your staff or contrac.st: Mokhoa oa ho lefa basebetsi kapa borakonteraka ba hau. O ka ntlafatsa sena maemong a Payroll neng kapa neng.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.nso: Kamoo o lefelago bašomi ba gago goba borakontraka. O ka hlwekišwa se ka go dipeakanyo tša Lenaneo la Megolo nako efe goba efe.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.tn: Ka moo o duelang badiri kgotsa borakonteraka ba gago ka teng. O ka tokafatsa seno mo diseting tsa Payroll nako nngwe le nngwe.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.ts: Ndlela leyi u hakelaka vatirhi va wena kumbe tikontiraka ha yona. U nga antswisa leswi eka swiletelo swa Payroll nkarhi wihi na wihi.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.ve: Nḓila ine na lifha ngayo vhashumi vhaṋu kana vhakonṱiraka. Ni nga khwinisa hezwi kha zwishumiswa zwa Payroll tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.
How you compensate your staff or contrac.ss: Indlela loncephetela ngayo tisebenti takho nobe bosonkontileka. Ungakucolisa loku kumasethingi e-Payroll noma nini.

Run a custom CPC campaign with full cont.ss: Gijima umkhankhaso we-CPC ngekwemkhuba ngekulawula ngalokuphelele kusabelomali sakho sonkhe, umkhawulo wemalanga onkhe, kanye nekubhida ngekuchofota.

Our trust & safety team will review your.xh: Iqela lethu lethemba kunye nokhuseleko lizakuphonononga ingxelo yakho. Unokuqhagamshelwa ukuba sifuna ulwazi oluthe kratya.
Our trust & safety team will review your.st: Sehlopha sa rona sa ts'epo le polokeho se tla hlahloba tlaleho ea hau. U ka ikopanya le uena haeba re hloka lintlha tse ling.
Our trust & safety team will review your.nso: Sehlopha sa rena sa go bota & polokego se tla sekaseka pego ya gago. O ka ikgokaganya le wena ge re nyaka tshedimošo ye ntši.
Our trust & safety team will review your.tn: Setlhopha sa rona sa tshepo le pabalesego se tla sekaseka pegelo ya gago. O ka nna wa ikgolaganya le wena fa re tlhoka tshedimosetso e nngwe.
Our trust & safety team will review your.ts: Xipano xa hina xa trust & safety xi ta kambisisa xiviko xa wena. U nga ha tihlanganisa na wena loko hi lava vuxokoxoko byo tala.
Our trust & safety team will review your.ve: Tshigwada tshashu tsha trust & safety tshi do sedzulusa muvhigo wavho. Ni nga kwamiwa arali ri tshi ṱoḓa mafhungo o engedzeaho.
Our trust & safety team will review your.ss: Licembu letfu lekwetsemba & lekuphepha litawubuyeketa umbiko wakho. Ungatsintfwa nangabe sidzinga lwati lolubanti.

Pick from this provider's available slot.af: Kies uit hierdie verskaffer se beskikbare gleuwe. Hulle kan steeds 'n ander tyd in hul aanbod voorstel.
Pick from this provider's available slot.zu: Khetha ezindaweni ezitholakalayo zalo mhlinzeki. Bangase baphakamise isikhathi esihlukile ekunikezeni kwabo.
Pick from this provider's available slot.xh: Khetha kwiindawo zokubeka ezikhoyo kulomboneleli. Basenokucebisa ixesha elahlukileyo kunikezelo lwabo.
Pick from this provider's available slot.st: Khetha ho tsoa libakeng tse fumanehang tsa motsweletsi ona. Ba ntse ba ka etsa tlhahiso ea nako e fapaneng tlhahisong ea bona.
Pick from this provider's available slot.nso: Kgetha go tšwa go di-slot tše di lego gona tša moabi yo. Ba sa dutše ba ka šišinya nako e fapanego mphong ya bona.
Pick from this provider's available slot.tn: Tlhopha mo diphatlheng tse di leng teng tsa motlamedi yono. Ba ka nna ba bo ba sa ntse ba tshitshinya nako e e farologaneng mo mpho ya bone.
Pick from this provider's available slot.ts: Hlawula eka swivandla leswi kumekaka swa muphakeri loyi. Va nga ha ringanyeta nkarhi lowu hambaneke eka nyiko ya vona.
Pick from this provider's available slot.ve: Khethani kha zwikhala zwi re hone zwa muṋetshedzi uyu. Vha nga kha ḓi ṋea nyeletshedzo ya tshifhinga tsho fhambanaho kha tshifhiwa tshavho.
Pick from this provider's available slot.ss: Khetsa kuletikhala letikhona talomhlinzeki. Bangase basaphakamise sikhatsi lesehlukile ekuniketeni kwabo.

All refunds are issued as store credit t.af: Alle terugbetalings word as winkelkrediet aan jou Beautonomi-beursie uitgereik, beperk tot bedrae wat reeds betaal is.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.zu: Konke ukubuyiselwa kwemali kukhishwa njengekhredithi yasesitolo esikhwameni sakho Beautonomi, esikhawulelwe emananini asekhokhelwe kakade.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.xh: Zonke iimali ezibuyiswayo zikhutshwa njengetyala levenkile kwisipaji sakho Beautonomi, zilinganiselwe kwizixa esele zihlawulwe.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.st: Lichelete tsohle li fanoe e le mokitlane oa lebenkele sepacheng sa hau sa Beautonomi, li lekanyelitsoe ho chelete e seng e lefshoa.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.nso: Dipušetšo ka moka di ntšhwa bjalo ka mokitlana wa lebenkele go sepache sa gago sa Beautonomi, e lekanyeditšwe go ditšhelete tšeo di šetšego di lefilwe.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.tn: Dipusetso tsotlhe di ntshiwa jaaka sekoloto sa lebenkele mo sepatšheng sa gago sa Beautonomi, se lekanyeditswe go madi a a setseng a duetswe.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.ts: Ku tlheriseriwa mali hinkwayo ku humesiwa tanihi xikweleti xa xitolo eka xipachi xa wena xa Beautonomi, ku pimiwile eka mali leyi se yi hakeriweke.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.ve: Zwoṱhe zwine zwa vhuiswa zwi bviswa sa tshikolodo tsha vhengele kha tshipatshi tshaṋu tsha Beautonomi, zwo linganelaho kha tshelede dzo no badelwaho.
All refunds are issued as store credit t.ss: Tonkhe timali letibuyiselwako tikhishwa njengesikweleti sesitolo esikhwameni sakho se-Beautonomi, tilinganiselwe emananini lavele akhokhelwe.

Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.af: Skakel kennisgewings in Instellings aan om besprekings, boodskappe, uitbetalingopdaterings en dringende waarskuwings te ontvang.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.zu: Vula izaziso kokuthi Izilungiselelo ukuze uthole ukubhukha, imilayezo, izibuyekezo zenkokhelo, nezixwayiso eziphuthumayo.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.xh: Layita izaziso kwiiSetingi ukufumana ubhukisho, imiyalezo, uhlaziyo lwentlawulo, kunye nezilumkiso ezingxamisekileyo.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.st: Laeta litemoso ho Litlhophiso hore u fumane litumellano, melaetsa, ditsebiso tsa ditefo, le ditemoso tsa kapele.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.nso: Bulela ditsebišo go Dipeakanyo go amogela dipeeletšo, melaetša, diapdeite tša tefo, le ditemošo tša ka pela.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.tn: Tobetsa dikitsiso mo Diseting gore o amogele dipeeletso, melaetsa, dintšhwafatso tsa tuelo, le ditsiboso tse di potlakileng.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.ts: Pfula switiviso eka Switirhisiwa ku amukela tibuku, marungula, ku pfuxetiwa ka ku hakela, na switsundzuxo swa xihatla.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.ve: Kha vha vule nḓivhadzo kha Settings u itela u wana dzibugu, milaedza, mvelaphanḓa ya mbadelo, na nḓivhadzo dzo ṱavhanyiswaho.
Turn on notifications in Settings to rec.ss: Vula tatiso ku-Settings kute utfole kubhukha, imilayeto, tibuyeketo tekukhokha, kanye netecwayiso letiphutfumako.

· Serial not assigned yet — card paymen.zu: · I-serial ayinikeziwe okwamanje — izinkokhelo zekhadi zihlala zingatholakali kuze kube Beautonomi babhalisa lo mshini
· Serial not assigned yet — card paymen.xh: · Uthotho alabelwe okwangoku — iintlawulo zekhadi zihlala zingafumaneki de Beautonomi ubhalise lo matshini
· Serial not assigned yet — card paymen.st: · Serili ha e so abeloe — litefo tsa karete li lula li le sieo ho fihlela Beautonomi e ngolisa mochini ona
· Serial not assigned yet — card paymen.nso: · Serial ga se ya abelwa ga bjale — ditefelo tša karata di dula di sa hwetšagale go fihlela Beautonomi e ngwadiša motšhene wo

· Serial not assigned yet — card paymen.ve: · Serial a i athu ṋewa — mbadelo dza khadi dzi dzula dzi siho u swikela Beautonomi i tshi ṅwalisa mutshini uyu

The first appointment is on the calendar.af: Die eerste afspraak is op die kalender. Gebruik jou Yoco terminaal om kaartbetaling te voltooi.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.zu: I-aphoyintimenti yokuqala isekhalendeni. Sebenzisa itheminali yakho Yoco ukuqedela inkokhelo yekhadi.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.xh: Idinga lokuqala likwikhalenda. Sebenzisa iterminal yakho Yoco ukugqiba intlawulo yekhadi.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.st: Kopano ea pele e khalendareng. Sebelisa Yoco theminale ea hao ho tlatsa tefo ea karete.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.nso: Peeletšo ya mathomo e almanaka. Diriša theminali ya gago ya Yoco go phetha tefo ya karata.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.tn: Peelanonako ya ntlha e mo khalentareng. Dirisa theminale ya gago ya Yoco go feleletsa tuelo ya karata.
The first appointment is on the calendar.ts: Ku hlangana ko sungula ku le ka khalendara. Tirhisa theminali ya wena ya Yoco ku hetisa ku hakela hi khadi.{{extra}}
The first appointment is on the calendar.ve: U vhewa ha u thoma hu kha khalenda. Shumisani theminala yaṋu ya Yoco u fhedza u badela nga garaṱa.
The first appointment is on the calendar.ss: Kubekwa kwekucala kusekhalendeni. Sebentisa itheminali yakho Yoco kute ucedzele kukhokha ngelikhadi.

Earn reward points when you post to Expl.af: Verdien beloningspunte wanneer jy na Explore plaas. Deel jou werk om sigbaarheid te vergroot en belonings te ontsluit.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.zu: Zuza amaphoyinti omklomelo uma uthumela ku-Explore. Yabelana ngomsebenzi wakho ukuze ukhulise ukubonakala futhi uvule imiklomelo.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.xh: Fumana amanqaku okuvuza xa uposa ku Explore. Yabelana ngomsebenzi wakho ukuze ukhule ukubonakala kwaye uvule imivuzo.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.st: Fumana lintlha tsa meputso ha u beha ho Explore. Arolelana mosebetsi oa hau ho holisa ponahalo le ho bula meputso.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.nso: Hwetša dintlha tša moputso ge o phatlalatša go Explore. Abelana mošomo wa gago go godiša go bonagala le go notlolla meputso.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.tn: Bona dintlha tsa tuelo fa o phouseta mo go Explore. Abelana tiro ya gago go godisa go bonala le go lotlolola dituelo.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.ts: Kuma tiphuphu ta hakelo loko u posta eka Explore. Avelana ntirho wa wena ku kurisa ku vonaka na ku pfula hakelo.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.ve: Kha vha wane mbuelo dza mbuelo musi vha tshi posa kha Explore. Kovhelanani mushumo waṋu u itela u alusa u vhonala na u vula malamba.
Earn reward points when you post to Expl.ss: Tfola emaphuzu emvuzo uma uposa ku Explore. Yabelana ngemsebenti wakho kute ukhule kubonakala futsi uvule imivuzo.

Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.af: Tik enige ry hieronder om handmatige aftrekkings, LBS, WVF of notas aan te pas terwyl hierdie lopie nog 'n konsep is.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.zu: Thepha noma yimuphi umugqa ngezansi ukuze ulungise izimali ezibanjwayo mathupha, i-PAYE, i-UIF, noma amanothi ngenkathi lokhu kugijima kusalungiswa.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.xh: Cofa kuwo nawuphi na umqolo ongezantsi ukuze uhlengahlengise ukutsalwa kwesandla ngesandla, i-PAYE, i-UIF, okanye amanqaku ngelixa olu balekayo luseluyilo.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.st: Tobetsa mola ofe kapa ofe o ka tlase ho lokisa litheolelo ka letsoho, PAYE, UIF, kapa lintlha ha mokhoa ona e ntse e le moralo.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.nso: Tlanya mothalo ofe goba ofe ka fase go beakanya diphokoletšo tša seatla, PAYE, UIF, goba dinoutse mola go kitima mo e sa le sengwalwa sa go ngwalwa.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.tn: Konya mola mongwe le mongwe o o fa tlase go baakanya dikgogo tsa diatla, PAYE, UIF, kgotsa dintlha fa go taboga gono go sa ntse go le terafote.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.ts: Thepha layini yin’wana na yin’wana laha hansi ku lulamisa ku hungutiwa ka manual, PAYE, UIF, kumbe tinotsi loko ku tsutsuma loku ka ha ri tsalwa.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.ve: Kha vha ṋaṋise mutevhe ufhio na ufhio u re afho fhasi u itela u dzudzanya u bviswa ha tshelede nga zwanḓa, PAYE, UIF, kana notsi ngeno u gidima uhu hu tshi kha ḓi vha mvetamveto.
Tap any row below to adjust manual deduc.ss: Thepha noma ngumuphi umugca longentasi kute ulungise kubanjwa kwemali ngesandla, i-PAYE, i-UIF, noma emanothi ngesikhatsi lokugijima kuseluhlaka.

A stamped account confirmation letter fr.af: 'n Gestempelde rekeningbevestigingsbrief van jou bank (jy kan dit van jou banktoepassing aflaai).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.zu: Incwadi yokuqinisekisa i-akhawunti enesitembu evela ebhange lakho (ungakwazi ukulanda lokhu kuhlelo lwakho lokusebenza lwasebhange).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.xh: Ileta egxininisiweyo yokuqinisekisa iakhawunti evela kwibhanki yakho (ungayikhuphela le kwi-app yakho yebhanki).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.st: Lengolo la netefatso la ak'haonte le tiisitsoeng ho tsoa bankeng ea hau (o ka khoasolla sena ho sesebelisoa sa hau sa banka).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.nso: Lengwalo la tiišetšo ya akhaonto ye e setempetšwego go tšwa pankeng ya gago (o ka taonelouta se go tšwa go tirišo ya gago ya panka).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.tn: Lekwalo la netefatso ya akhaonto le le nang le setempe go tswa kwa bankeng ya gago (o ka laisolola seno mo app ya gago ya banka).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.ts: Papila ro tiyisisa akhawunti leri nga na xitempe ku suka ebangi ya wena (u nga kopa leswi eka app ya wena ya le bangi).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.ve: Vhurifhi ha u khwaṱhisedza akhaunthu ho ṱamiwaho u bva kha bannga yaṋu (ni nga dawuniḽouda hezwi kha app yaṋu ya bannga).
A stamped account confirmation letter fr.ss: Incwadzi yekucinisekisa i-akhawunti lenesitembu levela ebhange lakho (ungayi-downloada loku ku-app yakho yasebhange).

Your account uses one-time codes or soci.af: Jou rekening gebruik eenmalige kodes of sosiale aanmelding. Stuur 'n verifikasiekode en kies dan 'n wagwoord.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.zu: I-akhawunti yakho isebenzisa amakhodi esikhathi esisodwa noma ukungena ngemvume komphakathi. Thumela ikhodi yokuqinisekisa, bese ukhetha iphasiwedi.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.xh: Iakhawunti yakho isebenzisa iikhowudi zexesha elinye okanye ukungena kwezentlalo. Thumela ikhowudi yokuqinisekisa, emva koko ukhethe igama lokugqitha.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.st: Ak'haonte ea hau e sebelisa likhoutu tsa nako e le 'ngoe kapa ho kena sechabeng. Romela khoutu ea netefatso, ebe u khetha senotlolo.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.nso: Akhaonto ya gago e šomiša dikhoutu tša nako e tee goba go tsena ga leago. Romela khoutu ya netefatšo, ke moka o kgethe phasewete.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.tn: Akhaonto ya gago e dirisa dikhoutu tsa nako e le nngwe kgotsa go tsena mo setšhabeng. Romela khoutu ya netefatso, o bo o tlhopha nomoro ya sephiri.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.ts: Akhawunti ya wena yi tirhisa tikhodi ta nkarhi wun’we kumbe ku nghena eka social. Rhumela khodi yo tiyisisa, kutani u hlawula phaswedi.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.ve: Akhaunthu yaṋu i shumisa khoudu dza tshifhinga tshithihi kana u dzhena kha matshilisano. Rumelani khoudu ya u khwaṱhisedza, nga murahu ni khethe password.
Your account uses one-time codes or soci.ss: I-akhawunti yakho isebentisa emakhodi esikhatsi sinye nobe kungena ngemvume kwetenhlalo. Tfumela ikhodi yekucinisekisa, bese ukhetsa iphasiwedi.

This feature is being finalized in nativ.af: Hierdie kenmerk word in moedertaal gefinaliseer. Gebruik die verwante oorspronklike afdelings terwyl ontplooiing voltooi word.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.zu: Lesi sici siphothulwa ngomdabu. Sebenzisa izigaba zomdabu ezihlobene ngenkathi ukukhishwa kuqedwa.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.xh: Olu phawu luyagqityezelwa ngokomthonyama. Sebenzisa amacandelo anxulumeneyo ngelixa ukukhutshwa kugqityiwe.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.st: Karolo ena e phetheloa ka puo ea khale. Sebelisa likarolo tsa tlhaho tse amanang ha tlhahiso e phethela.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.nso: Sebopego se se phethwa ka setlogo. Šomiša dikarolo tša setlogo tše di amanago ge go phatlalatšwa go phethwa.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.tn: Ntlha eno e a konosediwa ka puo ya naga. Dirisa dikarolo tsa tlholego tse di amanang le tsone fa go tsenngwa tirisong go ntse go wediwa.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.ts: Xivumbeko lexi xi le ku hetisisiwa hi ririmi ra ntumbuluko. Tirhisa swiyenge swa ntumbuluko leswi fambelanaka loko ku humesiwa ku ri karhi ku hela.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.ve: Tshipiḓa itshi tshi khou fhedzwa nga luambo lwa ḓamuni. Shumisani zwipiḓa zwa mvelele zwi tshimbilelanaho musi u phaḓaladzwa hu tshi khou fhela.
This feature is being finalized in nativ.ss: Lesi sici siyaphetfwa ngesilungu semdzabu. Sebentisa tincenye letihlobene temdzabu ngesikhatsi kukhishwa kuphelile.

Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.af: Grootboekskandering het die veiligheidspet getref - totale kan onvolledig wees. Vernou die datumreeks vir volle akkuraatheid.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.zu: Iskena se-Ledger sifinyelela isiphetho sokuphepha - amanani angase angaphelele. Nciphisa ibanga ledethi ukuze uthole ukunemba okugcwele.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.xh: I-Ledger scan ibethe ikepusi yokhuseleko — iitotali zisenokungaphelelanga. Nciphisa uluhlu lomhla ukuchaneka okupheleleyo.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.st: Ledger scan e otla sekoaelo sa polokeho - lipalo-palo e kanna ea ba tse sa fellang. Namahanya nako bakeng sa ho nepahala ka botlalo.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.nso: Ledger skena otla polokeho cap, - palo yohle ka 'na ba sa feletseng. Fokotša letšatšikgwedi la go nepagala ka botlalo.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.tn: Ledger scan otla polokeho cap - dipalopalo ka 'na ba sa phethahala. Fokotsa selekanyo sa matlha gore o nepe ka botlalo.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.ts: Ledger scan yi hlasele xifunengeto xa vuhlayiseki — ti totala ti nga ha va ti nga helelanga. Pfuxeta nxaxamelo wa masiku leswaku wu pakanisa hi ku helela.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.ve: Ledger scan yo rwa tshipiḓa tsha tsireledzo — ṱhanganyelo dzi nga vha dzi songo fhelela. Fhungudzani tshifhinga tsha maḓuvha u itela u wana vhungoho ho fhelelaho.
Ledger scan hit the safety cap — totals.ss: Ledger scan hit cap kuphepha - inani lingase lingaphelele. Nciphisa libanga lelusuku kute uciniseke ngalokugcwele.

This address doesn't have coordinates. D.zu: Leli kheli alinazo izixhumanisi. Beka iphinikhodi kumephu, noma susa bese wengeza leli kheli futhi.
This address doesn't have coordinates. D.xh: Le dilesi ayinazo izinxibelelanisi. Beka iphini kwimephu, okanye ucime kwaye wongeze le dilesi kwakhona.
This address doesn't have coordinates. D.st: Aterese ena ha e na likhokahano. Lahlela phini 'mapeng, kapa hlakola le ho kenya aterese ena hape.
This address doesn't have coordinates. D.nso: Aterese ye ga e na dihlomathišo. Lahlela pini mmapeng, goba o phumole gomme o oketše aterese ye gape.
This address doesn't have coordinates. D.tn: Aterese eno ga e na ditekanyetso. Latlhela pine mo mmapeng, kgotsa phimola o bo o tsenya aterese eno gape.
This address doesn't have coordinates. D.ts: Adirese leyi a yi na tikhodixini. Lahlela pini emepeni, kutani u susa ivi u engetela adirese leyi nakambe.
This address doesn't have coordinates. D.ve: Ḓiresi iyi a i na dzikhoudini. Kha vha pose pini kha mapa, kana vha phumule vha engedze ḓiresi iyi hafhu.
This address doesn't have coordinates. D.ss: Lelikheli alinawo emakhodi. Lahla ipini ebalazweni, noma ususe bese wengeta lelikheli futsi.

If you completed payment, your booking w.af: As jy betaling voltooi het, sal jou bespreking binnekort verskyn. Jy kan Besprekings in jou profiel nagaan.
If you completed payment, your booking w.zu: Uma uqedele ukukhokha, ukubhukha kwakho kuzovela maduzane. Ungahlola Ukubhuka kuphrofayela yakho.
If you completed payment, your booking w.xh: Ukuba uyigqibile intlawulo, ukubhukisha kwakho kuya kubonakala kungekudala. Ungajonga uBhukisho kwiprofayile yakho.
If you completed payment, your booking w.st: Haeba u qetile ho lefa, peeletso ea hau e tla hlaha haufinyane. U ka sheba Bookings profilaneng ea hau.
If you completed payment, your booking w.nso: Ge e ba o phethile tefo, peeletšo ya gago e tla tšwelela kgauswinyane. O ka hlahloba Bookings ka profil ya gago.
If you completed payment, your booking w.tn: Fa o weditse go duela, peeletso ya gago e tla tlhagelela mo nakong e khutshwane. O ka tlhola Dipeeletso mo porofaeleng ya gago.
If you completed payment, your booking w.ts: Loko u hetile ku hakela, ku bukuta ka wena ku ta humelela ku nga ri khale. U nga kambela Bookings eka profile ya wena.
